scenes.say: Your ground coffee is going stale.
Air is the main culprit. Seal it tight.
Light dulls flavor. Choose an opaque jar.
Heat and moisture hurt too. Skip the spot by the oven.
Sealed, it stays best for one to two weeks.
Buy small bags, more often. That beats a big bag that sits.
Sealed, dark, cool, and soon. Save this for your next bag.
